title: Explaining the disconnect between geopolitics and markets
executive_summary: The video discusses the disconnect between geopolitics and markets, featuring Joyce Chang and Derek Chollet from JPMorgan Chase. They recap key takeaways from the IMF-World Bank Spring Meetings 2026, focusing on uncertainty, geopolitical tensions, energy disruptions, and tariff developments.

asset_allocation_views: Caution on equities due to geopolitical uncertainty
profile_data.market_outlook: Neutral to slightly bearish in the short term due to geopolitical risks, with potential for market volatility
